# Positive compact-packet open-path clock for a fixed finite background

A finite supplied waveform can be approximated by a static qubit clock whose clock bonds form an ordinary nearest-neighbor open path. The data Hamiltonian stays present throughout the run. The estimate retains the actual free clock state, the complete data output and any passive reference, for one specified prepared clock packet over a fixed finite horizon.

**Current status.** Root accepted the exact analytic source `a59c38c7352931da0a5df51c2bca63ddbbe37fd302a18d5a36347235083c967b` under acceptance `b2e9ff7716317dfc5b69bb31735c936b79005fba0100e307282399893eb71b8f`, after the separate complete review `ca8d031b982414cd796c524252e5488e9dae03b6d3cc1145bd29c199ee6ac32b`. Root accepted source assembly dc606d7d under OPEN_PATH_CLOCK_ASSEMBLY_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json SHA 3bc01c3773cc26669c4c26c60172bd1504566f64f450768f0b63c4424bd430fc and review d96c9b7c9a0b48a58419f641cf8a0c31dbfcee7b9a529cb5473124ae1f74e2b3. This publication rendering and driver require separate exact root acceptance; no retained audit or native physical realization is supplied. The complete source below is unchanged, including its historical pending-review language and descriptions written before its selected calculation. Current status is recorded here rather than silently substituted into those historical bytes.

The mathematical estimate uses a compact C3 packet, its actual initial sampled normalization, the true endpoint diagonal terms and zero ghost values, and two residual-Duhamel comparisons. The second comparison targets the normalized actual free open-path clock. For the supplied finite waveform, equation (27) bounds the full prepared-map operator error uniformly for `0 <= t <= T`; its localization term retains the sampled factor `C_t/C_0`. Refining the mesh at fixed packet width and smoothing order leaves a localization/smoothing error floor. The sufficient parameter prescription changes all three parameters and raises the required physical strengths. The program coordinate spacing is not the physical qubit spacing.

The positive clock bonds act on neighboring qubits of a unit-spaced open path; there is no closing bond. Clock-data terms have at most three sites but generally long range, with the data incidence of the duplicated endpoint charged. The original data interactions, including literal periodic seams and the scalar part, remain. The theorem keeps the complete recurrence duration T, all inherited data/reference/dirty-factor domains, and both unnormalized binary-admission blocks. Neutral preparation retains its separate clean-input requirement. The ordinary-neighbor claim covers clock bonds, not the entire apparatus.

The clock's full-space norm `(N-1)/a`, sector norm bound `2/a`, initial mean `1/a` and actual finite variance are distinct costs. The total energy formula retains data/program covariance and the difference between the mean square and the square of the mean. Positive clock bonds do not make arbitrary H plus a signed program positive. The separately offered positive model pays the full reserve `h I + c N_C`, including its exact phase and mean. Number-preserving sector errors, arbitrary leakage, joint preparation error and whole-run timing have distinct budgets. Addressed packet preparation requires clean input, external timing and removal or compensation of its drift; data admission must respect that preparation interval. Terminal dephasing is a mathematical channel, not a constructed physical reader, stopping device or stored record.

The actual mathematical roles are these. Complete raw bodies and unique canonical extraction ranges are bound in `DEPENDENCIES.json` and `PARENT_BODY_RANGES.json`; the narrower uses in this table govern reuse.

| Source | Actual role |
| --- | --- |

| [Finite Gauss penalty](FINITE_GAUSS_PENALTY_RECOVERY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Literal full-space H, scalar and whole-term budget; no initial-code recovery or all-time theorem is imported. |
| [Fixed neutral-ray preparation](FIXED_NEUTRAL_RAY_PREPARATION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Supplied finite preparation word and its clean-input/dirty-return domain. |
| [Coherent binary admission](COHERENT_BINARY_K_ADMISSION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Supplied coherent word, clean work/flag and both unnormalized outputs on arbitrary active/reference input. |
| [Fixed-background control](LITERAL_L4_FIXED_BACKGROUND_CONTROL_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Full-phase waveform certificate and whole recurrence time, with effective supplied data. Actual publication: PR9552. |
| [Generic autonomous Fourier supplier](AUTONOMOUS_LOCAL_SUPPLIER_OF_ORIGINAL_ROTOR_RECORDS_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-30.md) | Generic characteristic and positive-smoothing mechanism, with the needed finite estimates derived in the proof. No rotor or collision law is imported. |
| [Autonomous waveform bridge](LITERAL_L4_AUTONOMOUS_CLOCK_BRIDGE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Accepted arbitrary-H application interface and inherited complete reference scope. Actual publication: PR9555. |

The existing positive finite-path suppliers keep their original conserving-payload and spectral-battery scopes and attribution in the proof and archived route records. Generic positive clocks, transport, smoothing, Taylor consistency and unitary stability are existing machinery. Neither unary-cycle nor clock-resource sharpening is a mathematical premise here. The actual procedural stack parent is regular PR9559 at d83ac7eabd6fffa7bf2a941c3dffd070796a53db on physics-loop/toe-unary-cycle-clock-20261014. Its theorem is not imported. Seven mathematical citations above retain their actual published bindings, including autonomous PR9555 and fixed-background PR9552. Current PARENT_BINDINGS.json governs publication; initial pending binding and assembly/footer statuses remain immutable historical records. The graph proposal follows these citations; no graph program was run during source preparation.

The evidence archive preserves the complete author, separate-review and root packets with their original exposure records, programs, streams, clarification and failures. The separately selected control was planned, executed and sealed before the reviewer's first candidate exposure, within a shared route and prior same-family clock context. It is a finite calculation, not blind or model-diverse validation, a diamond-norm numerical certificate, or a proof by agreement. The fixed-width floor, reversed hopping, omitted phase/background, invalid endpoint and nonconstant sampled-normalization controls remain evidence of their stated scopes. Source reconstruction checks evaluate zero mathematical predicates and replay none of those calculations.

The supported result is conditional on the supplied finite model, waveform certificate, couplings, packet, precision and readout interface. It gives no native energy origin, common fixed cap, efficient fabrication, arbitrary initial clock-state, permanent-storage or all-time autonomous-computation conclusion. The full accepted source begins below.
